title: You can sleep on this haunted ship

slides.text: YOU CAN SLEEP ON THIS HAUNTED SHIP
The RMS Queen Mary. Launched in 1934, one of the fastest ocean liners in the world.
In World War II she carried thousands of soldiers at a time. Painted grey, they called her the Grey Ghost.
October 1942. She accidentally sliced through her own escort, the British cruiser HMS Curacoa. More than 300 sailors died.
Under wartime orders, she could not stop.
In 1967 she sailed to Long Beach, California... and never left. Today she's a hotel.
Guests and staff report footsteps in empty halls and children's laughter near the old first-class pool.
One stateroom, B340, got so many complaints it was closed to guests for years.
Today you can book a night on board. Would you?
